domain: online fractional general set cover, m unit-cost sets
adversary: adaptive against a fixed deterministic online algorithm
quantifiers: every deterministic algorithm and every integer m>=1
target: there is an instance with perfect optimal-dual prediction, OPT=1, and ALG>=H_m
verdict_rule: corrected adversary derives H_m, perfect prediction is noninformative, independent checker passes, and printed H_m-1 construction is rejected
